The scene is first-person present tense in one location. It must stay under 1000 words. The spine is Julian stepping forward to shield Lirael from witnesses. Lirael must choose between accepting his contact or breaking it to speak. LI must have at least one meaningful moment.

The scene must be a non-consummate entry with no micro-decision. It needs a history note and a state-change beat. The location is the ritual clearing after the interrupted interrogation. The player's step back must be metabolized into the scene.
